'''Sulfur Deposit''' is the renamed deepslate redstone ore.

== Obtaining ==
=== Natural generation ===
The deepslate part of the vanilla redstone feature.

=== Breaking ===
Mined with a pickaxe (see [[Tools#Mining levels]]), it drops 1–2 [[Sulfur Chunk|sulfur chunks]]. Silk Touch drops the block.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/deepslate_redstone_ore.json}}</ref>
